3D Model
Rhino is built from the design model; the other formats export the current 3D view as meshes. Metres. .skp and .rvt are closed formats — use the interchange file each app imports natively.
Animated axonometric
Duration10 s
Vehicles1
People2
Vehicles on the travel lanes, bikes in bike lanes, people on the sidewalks and through the parklet. Follows the Schematic / Technical appearance; far-side buildings are cut away so the street reads. MP4 is not available: browsers can only record WebM — convert with HandBrake or ffmpeg if you need MP4. Nothing in the design is changed.

Precision
Site Objects
Access Chamber
Manholes, valves & grates must stay accessible. Parklet must clear by 1 m min. (C09)
Fire Hydrant
1.5 m clearance required at each end of the parklet from any hydrant. (C05)
Utility Pole
1.0 m clearance min; 2.4 m if trolley wires are present on this block. (C07)
Signal Controller
Traffic signal boxes & electrical kiosks need 1.5 m clearance from the parklet. (C08)
Driveway / Lane
Parklet must maintain 1.5 m setback from any driveway or lane opening at each end. (C06)

General

Stored in this browser only; not shared between devices.

Connections

Photoreal renders, the Assistant and street context photos each use your own account with the service. Add a key for the ones you want; nothing else needs one.

ReplicatePhotoreal renders

Get a token at replicate.com/account/api-tokens (pricing). Stored only in this browser; never sent to Curbside’s servers or saved with your design.

AnthropicThe Design Assistant

Get a key at console.anthropic.com/settings/keys (pricing). Stored only in this browser; never sent to Curbside’s servers or saved with your design.

MapillaryStreet context photos

Create an app and copy its client token at mapillary.com/dashboard/developers (free). Stored only in this browser; never sent to Curbside’s servers or saved with your design.
